title: Everyone turns when someone shouts Hey, Bat
summary: At a Batiste family concert rehearsal, a shout of Hey Bat made twenty musicians turn around.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You know, we was talking a while back about the Batistas and how many Batistas there are. I'll tell you, this is not a joke, this is a reality what happened. Four years ago, there was preparation for the Jazz Fest. It was a Thursday night. And on that Saturday, there would be a concert with the Batistas. Alvin played, Harold played, I played, I think it was a drummer that played. And all the Batistas brothers and their sons and everything. All of us played. It was about 27 or 28 of us, you know. That Thursday night, we went to the Musicians Hall and we had a rehearsal. We was in there playing and so forth and so forth. Somebody comes to the door and he knocks on the door and he sticks his head in there and he says, Hey, Bat! And all 27 of us said, 20 people turned.
It was a kick, man. That actually happened, man.
